method: Executed: the real EntityTracker (mn.a(sa), mn.b(sa), mn.a()) with real EntityTrackerEntry objects in its one HashSet for real chickens, items, arrows, snowballs and orbs and an EntityPlayerMP stand-in, added in loadedEntityList order. Per tick a World.updateEntities stand-in sets each entity scripted state at its list index, removes a dead one at its own index (real untrackEntity, which queues the id in the player destroyedItemsNetCache) and runs the player first-thing flush at the player slot (mw.h offsets 74-179, bytecode-read); then the real updateTrackedEntities runs. Packets are recorded as [kind, entity id, fields] in sending order. Batch 53 (tag b53tj, cases vehicles and vehiclesLast): the same walk with real boats (xi), minecarts (xl.a, types 0 and 1), paintings (tb), item frames (st), eyes of ender (zd) and fish hooks (xe, the angler is the player stand-in). Batch 54 (tag b54rt, cases extras and extrasLast): leash knots (su), firework rockets (zf), falling blocks (xj), primed TNT (xw) and thrown potions (zo). Batch 55 (tag b55dt, cases respawn, respawnLast, dimension, dimensionLast, earlySpawn, earlySpawnLast): the player respawn (real mn.b of the old player, a new EntityPlayerMP id at the end of the list, real mn.a of the new one), a dimension change (real mn.b in world A, real mn.a in world B with its own HashSet) and spawns made at the spawner slot before the player slot; the respawn and transfer calls of ServerConfigurationManager and the entity loop are stand-ins.
